primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: PFS is defined as the time from randomization to the earlier of disease progression or death due to any cause, as assessed by Independent Radiology Committee (IRC). The sponsor terminated the study early due to business reasons. As such, no data were collected for efficacy analyses.

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: As pre-specified in the protocol, a total of 140 PFS events were required for this analysis; given that only 54 participants were enrolled and the study terminated early after 9 months, no data were collected or analyzed as planned for this outcome measure.
